title: Soul Realms
description: Soul Realms is a high-quality Survival SMP server for Java & Bedrock with high-quality content, a friendly community, and the best staff team. Custom Origins, dynamic RPG mechanics, and deep lore-driven gameplay.
body:
Soul Realms is a high-quality Survival SMP server for Java & Bedrock with high-quality content, a friendly community, and the best staff team. Custom Origins, dynamic RPG mechanics, and deep lore-driven gameplay.

Choose your origin and Soul Alignment, forge your destiny, and shape the world through exploration, combat, and alliances. With custom abilities, quests, and an ever-evolving world, every journey is unique.
